name: needs-triage
description: Received; not yet classified by a maintainer

name: needs-info
description: Waiting on the reporter for the information a maintainer comment names

name: reproduced
description: A maintainer reproduced the report on current main

name: awaiting-release
description: Fixed on main; the fix ships in the next release of the named surface

name: drift
description: Spec, schemas, protocol.ts, implementation or corpus disagree with each other

name: conformance-gap
description: Already-specified behavior the conformance corpus does not pin

name: documentation
description: Documentation is wrong or missing; behavior is unchanged

name: spec-ambiguity
description: Spec text supports more than one conforming reading

name: adopter-specific
description: Behavior belongs to the reporting implementation, not to UWMD

name: needs-rfc
description: Resolving it changes what a conforming implementation must do

name: working-as-specified
description: Closed: the reported behavior is what the spec requires

name: wontfix
description: Closed: out of scope or declined
